title: IngestResult
description:
How an Ingest ended. Chunks written before any failure stay written, and a retry of the
same request skips them.

oneOf.description: Every mapping loaded and the created entities were swept.

report.description:
The load's report as the `ingest` crate writes it (`ingest::Report`). For display
and storage; its shape is not part of the contract.

oneOf.description: The load's marker records another ontology version: nothing was written.
The load is being deleted: nothing was written.

Building an index over data the graph already holds outlasted `helix.timeout_secs`:
nothing was written. Retry; the attempt doesn't count.

label.description: The node or edge label whose index was still building.

oneOf.description:
Streams the load holds were loaded from other snapshots or through other mappings, as
when the tables were re-synced while it was being written: nothing was written. Start a
new load.

The mappings don't fit the ontology or the sources: nothing was written, and a retry
fails the same way.

errors.description: Every problem, each naming its mapping.

oneOf.description: A source couldn't be read; a retry may succeed.

A write may or may not have committed. Retry the same request once the store has
settled: it skips the chunk if it committed.

chunk.description: Its position in the pass, from 0.

oneOf.description: The call was cancelled; the write in flight finished first.

report.description: What the load did before it stopped, as in [`IngestResult::Done`].

oneOf.description: Reading or writing the store failed, and nothing was left in doubt.

Pass.description:
The two passes of a load over a mapping's rows. A load commits the [`Pass::Create`] chunks
of every mapping before any [`Pass::Resolve`] chunk, so what rows report resolves against
every entity the load creates, whichever row or mapping creates it.

oneOf.description: What rows report: the properties they set on entities they don't create, and facts.

SourceChange.description: A stream loaded from one snapshot and mapping version, asked to load from others.

stored.description: The snapshot it was stored from.

stored_version.description: The mapping version it was stored through.

stream.description: The stream: its source and mapping, joined by U+001F.
